_comment: Per-package gzipped-size budgets in bytes. Measured against the ESM entry graph: dist/index.js plus every relative file it reaches, gzipped together, so a package that code-splits is still measured on what importing it costs. Tune up explicitly when a primitive batch lands; tune down when a refactor genuinely shrinks output. NOTE on @usemotif/icons: the dist barrel re-exports 1,933 lucide-derived glyphs; the budget reflects the full-barrel size, but real consumers tree-shake to ~100 B gz per imported icon (sideEffects: false guarantees it). NOTE on @usemotif/headless: raised from 25300 by 408 gzipped bytes of barrel. The package ships a directive-free entry that re-exports its client chunk by name, and that name list is the whole increase; the components themselves moved 4 bytes. Headroom is left at about 1 percent on purpose, matching this file's other entries, so that converting the remaining namespaces has to breach it and be argued rather than absorbed. NOTE on @usemotif/react, @usemotif/reset and @usemotif/migrate: these emit shared chunks alongside their entry, so their budgets were raised once to cover the whole graph rather than the entry fragment they used to be compared against.
